production.publisher_route: GitHub Actions publish.yml; conditional on IG_PUBLISH_ENABLED

release_requirements: Reconcile all 12 ledger records against live media IDs and ensure no duplicates
Verify approved closing logo, actual file hashes and carousel evidence
Verify editorial and source evidence for other queued items; inflation Reel owner approval is final
Host and hash-check approved Reel and cover; ensure hosted bytes match the exact owner-approved Santa R 1.0/V5 file
Complete explicit pilot transition authorization only after reconciled closure
Merge reviewed changes and verify production checks; only then permit scheduling
watchdog: no duplicate task or watchdog created
learning: Passing CI does not establish external Meta account, file integrity, hosting or publication readiness. Preserve fail-closed behavior. Owner editorial sign-off is not the same as hosted-byte identity; prior successful Meta delivery is evidence of an operational integration, with existing auth checks retained.
